releases.name: Cursed District: Horror
releases.summary:
An old factory district has stood silent for decades after a series of unexplained disappearances forced everyone to leave. Locals say the entire area is cursed, bound by ancient voodoo relics hidden throughout the abandoned buildings.

Determined to end the nightmare, you enter the district with one goal: find every cursed relic and break the curse once and for all. But as you search through abandoned factories, rusting warehouses, dark alleyways, and forgotten offices, you realize something else still calls this place home..

You can get bigger by eating stuff and you can decrease again if you puke!Hurray! You escaped! Unfortunately, the snake is eating his tail, you have to start again. releases.name: Flowstone Saga
releases.summary:
In the sleepy backwaters of Ocean's End, a young adventurer and her stalwart pet Sprig stumble on an ancient power hidden beneath long-forgotten ruins. With it, Mirai can harness the power to repair, build, and... fight.

Mirai will use these new powers to help build her home of New Riverstone, face growing threats like the Scarlet Tusk Pirates and Byzankar Empire, hunt for treasure across mountains, forests, temples, and ruins, and forge new friendships with people (and animals) across the world. Perhaps, the secrets of her past will finally be revealed as well...

Master a totally unique puzzle-battle system in this 16-bit, JRPG-inspired adventure featuring an epic story, charming characters, stunning pixel art, and epic music. Follow a grand story set in the mysterious Ocean's End islands full of lost memories, ancient ruins, pirates, treasures, and frogs.

releases.name: Hazard Pay
releases.summary:
The job is simple: destroy evidence. Leave no trace. Don’t die in the process.

Hazard Pay is a pixel-art block-pushing puzzler set in a crumbling dystopian world. You’ll navigate alone through abandoned and contaminated facilities, dodging environmental hazards while completing your employer’s checklist with calculated efficiency.

Dive into a world of stunning, realistic puzzles that captivate your eyes and mind. Piece by piece, reveal breathtaking images of beautiful women — each completed puzzle unlocks a new masterpiece, keeping you motivated to discover what’s next.

Smooth and intuitive touch controls make gameplay effortless and deeply satisfying — you’ll feel like you’re truly shaping every picture with your own hands. Gentle, soothing music sets the perfect mood, helping you unwind while your curiosity pulls you to complete the next challenge.

Relax, enjoy, and let yourself get lost in the details.

Features:

• Gorgeous, realistic artwork of women.
• Satisfying touch interaction — every move feels natural.
• Unlock new, even more stunning images as you progress.

Hide rings around your house, on top of a mountain or in a lake. They can be anywhere! Search for rings in the real world, while hiding them from your neighbors. Will you be the best player in town?Hide&Pick is a multi-player game with real-world navigation (using GPS) that lets you pick up and hide rings based on your current location. Play while walking, jogging, hiking or even swimming: you never know where rings are hidden. The real world is your playground.KEEP YOUR RINGS SAFEThe longer your rings remain undiscovered, the more points they earn. But wait too long and other players may pick them up!FOLLOW THE COMPASSPoint your Iphone north to find the nearest rings around you. Get within 50 meters of it and it's yours!STAY FITLook for rings by walking around your neighborhood, jogging in a park, hiking up a mountain or even swimming in a lake. releases.name: VTBattle It's Not About Subscribers! It's All About Power.
releases.summary:
Choose your “oshi” from 350+ VTubers! Battle your way through Roguelike, Card Game, and Auto-Battle gameplay!

■ Build Your Team with Your Favorite VTubers!
Over 350 VTubers from a wide range of genres—including game streamers, singers, ASMR creators, and illustrators—join the battle!

Every VTuber featured in the game can be used as your protagonist. Choose your favorite VTuber and take on the challenge!

■ Extensive Card Collection
Each of the 350+ VTubers has cards with different rarities!
Collect every card featuring your favorite VTubers and complete your collection!

■ Game System
Experience a unique blend of Card Game × Auto-Battle × Roguelite gameplay.
Set five cards and strengthen stats such as HP, ATK, DEF, MAG, MDEF, and SPD to defeat your rivals. Collect stronger cards as you progress and take on increasingly powerful opponents!

■ Skills & Levels — Every Card Has a Chance to Shine!
A card's strength is determined by its level and rarity, rather than the character itself.

releases.name: War the Knights
releases.summary:
With great explosive barrels comes great responsibility.

Sword? Check.
Horse? Of course.
Explosive barrels? You'd better believe it!

Choose your side, arm yourself with your favorite weapons, and charge into large-scale medieval battles. Fight with swords, bows, spears, crossbows, shields, and even magic. Capture flags to respawn closer to the front line, ride into combat on horseback, and use everything at your disposal to help your team claim victory.

Battle across snowy fields, islands, and mountain fortresses, experiment with different tactics, and always keep an eye on your surroundings—sometimes a single well-placed explosive barrel is all it takes to change the course of the battle.

releases.name: Rhythm Flow
releases.summary:
Feel the rhythm and hit every beat as you test your timing across a variety of energetic songs in this fast-paced music game.

Feel the rhythm and let the music guide every move in this exciting rhythm game where precision, timing, and quick reflexes are the keys to success. Follow the beat, hit every note with perfect accuracy, and challenge yourself across a variety of energetic tracks.

Each song offers a unique rhythm pattern designed to test your coordination and sense of timing. As the music becomes faster and more complex, you'll need to stay focused, maintain your combo, and strive for the highest score.

releases.name: Kpop idol Dress Up
releases.summary:
Become the ultimate K-pop fashion stylist in this colorful dress up game and create stunning looks for your singer with endless combinations of trendy outfits, hairstyles and accessories.

Hello fashion lover, are you ready to step into the spotlight? In Kpop Idol Dress Up, the stylish K-pop dress up game for Nintendo Switch™, you become the fashion stylist behind your very own idol. Create dazzling looks, mix trendy outfits, customize hairstyles and add eye-catching accessories to make your star shine on every stage.

Explore a colorful world of K-pop fashion and unleash your creativity with modern clothes, glamorous details and endless style combinations inspired by pop idols. Design your outfit for the stage as you create bold, energetic and fantasy-inspired looks.

Featured Features:
Endless K-pop outfit combinations: Mix and match stylish outfits, hairstyles and accessories to create unique looks for your K-pop idol.
Become a true fashion stylist: Design stage-ready looks, concert outfits and standout styles inspired by the exciting world of K-pop.
Photo Mode: Capture your favorite creations, save your best looks and share your pop star fashion moments with friends and family.
Full customization: Change hairstyles, hair colors and accessories to create the perfect makeover for every performance.
Made for fashion lovers of all ages: Whether you love dress up games, fashion games or creative styling, this game is made for you.
